context: Tests the distinct workflow for persistent heap growth when unreachable-leak scanning is empty, including region, heap, address, ownership, and allocation evidence.

checklist.name: Zero-leak meaning
checklist.description: States that zero unreachable leaks does not rule out reachable abandoned objects, expected caches, buffers, heap regression, or fragmentation.

checklist.name: Matched graphs
checklist.description: Requires baseline and post-flow graphs from the same build, runtime target, data, flow, cleanup wait, and Malloc Stack Logging setting.

checklist.name: Region comparison
checklist.description: Runs vmmap -summary on both graphs before choosing heap-specific analysis and uses the comparison to locate the growing region.

checklist.name: Heap diff shape
checklist.description: Uses the exact current command shape heap --diffFrom=baseline.memgraph post.memgraph for malloc-region growth.

checklist.name: Address lookup
checklist.description: Uses heap --addresses='<class-or-size-pattern>' post.memgraph to obtain concrete addresses for a suspicious type or size.

checklist.name: No-MSL path
checklist.description: Uses a bounded leaks --traceTree=<address> query when Malloc Stack Logging is unavailable.

checklist.name: MSL path
checklist.description: Uses malloc_history -fullStacks when Malloc Stack Logging is present and does not compare that run with logging-disabled captures.

checklist.name: Aggregate ownership
checklist.description: Uses leaks --referenceTree --groupByType when aggregate ownership clues are more useful than one address.

checklist.name: Raw artifacts
checklist.description: Preserves every raw command result with the graph pair and directs the operator to check each installed tool's --help for evolving flags.

checklist.name: Attributable proof
checklist.description: Verifies the identical repeated flow and requires removal or a justified bound for growth attributable to the same app type or allocation rather than relying on RSS alone.
